text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Alright, moving the siege tower unit... to the castle walls.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Right before the Arima Kinen.
The two of them play a siege warfare board game.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer.
Let's sort things out while playing around.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The mission that must be cleared
in the game known as the 'Arima Kinen.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As gamers, we know.
Winning isn't just about coming out on top—
it's about "fulfilling the win condition."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Instead of blindly aiming for 1st place,
we need to narrow down what to aim for this time
in order to reach our ultimate goal.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: The main objective is the 'Battle Against the Queen.' However, while still in the Classic year, you don't necessarily have to win.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What matters is racing on equal footing.
And earning her acknowledgment.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista is an Umamusume who commands overwhelming expectations
and captures the spotlight from all the fans.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I will make use of that 'authority bias.'
If she acknowledges me... I can prove that I am
the rightful successor to rule."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The secondary objective was "facing our classmates." Pisa, Rose, and
Flash Sun—all of us have safely reunited.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to make my three classmates
acknowledge me as the top player, too.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: There are tons of top contenders, but somehow, we'll muscle our way right through them—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'll dive right into the top three.
I'll push through with my signature long spurt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, two days before the race—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Regrettably...
I have decided to forgo running in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: It fills me with regret, but... this is for the clan's sake. We shall meet again at the New Year's garden.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Not feeling well...? No... Rose...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I told you, didn't I? It only becomes the greatest game
when everyone is gathered together.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Then... it's a blessing in disguise, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Let's pray for her swift recovery for now.
The Arima Kinen will be run by the four of us—me, Buena, Pisa,
and Flash-san—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Shall we play a four-player match...?
It's not like there are any other Rose-rank Umamusume around, after all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to working with you, Ruler-san.
The time has finally come.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
“Yes. By the way, Buena.
There is one thing I would like to ask you.”

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I hear you are striving for that "sublime view."
The scenery that can only be seen
after running a truly magnificent race.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Seeing that is my dream!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I see. Then today, I'll put in a great run myself, and—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I would love to catch a glimpse of that view.
Standing side by side with you, the reigning queen."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(If I do that, I can prove to the fans
that I am—an equal standing beside them.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The rivals that stand out are Buena Vista and her two classmates.
There don't seem to be any other Umamusume to keep a close eye on, but—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There was one Umamusume staring intently at Rulership. It was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "She is a sharp, intellectual Umamusume who serves as the chairwoman of the Expedition Support Committee."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even among a field of other strong rivals,
for some reason, she had eyes only for Rulership.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It's still... too early to say for sure.
Howeverâ

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Or perhaps, this place is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A light akin to sheer intimidation dwelt deep within their eyes.
It was truly eerie, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We must not forget the mission hierarchy.
The main priority this time is strictly the match against the Queen.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Yes, I know, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The Queen's castle.
I've finally breached its outer walls.
All that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
All we must do is storm the citadel and demand an audience.
I shall show them—a lightning-fast invasion.
